steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: That's the central elevator.
In front of you is a huge freight elevator that goes into the depths of the earth. Traces of recent frequent use are clearly visible.
The containers around it are shockingly piled full of various Mania weapons.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: So this is their arsenal, huh. No wonder they had the audacity to pick a fight with me.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: The aboveground part is only a warehouse. The equipment for assembling weapons should be underground, kept together with the inheritance.
The underground waves are becoming more and more intense. The feeling is similar to that when a Sinner corrupts, and it makes you even sicker.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Alright, all of you stand by here. Clean up the trash while you're at it.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Now, I'll go down with the Bureau's guys to retrieve the inheritance.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Are you kidding me? We've already fought the whole day, none of us is risking our lives to go down with you!

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You don't have to come. I only need your chief to follow me.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You...!

options: What if I attack you when no one else is around?
Why the rush? You know what happened to your subordinate?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Oh? You've given up resisting?

options: Because it's pointless to resist you.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Haha, you were a lot tougher when you were dealing with Yagyu.
Her tone sounds a little complimentary. But you can't care less about such things now.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Without me, you won't make it back out alive.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Also, I've seen too many people who want to kill me. You haven't got the kind of dead stare they have.
Indeed, you don't have that kind of stupid idea in your mind.
Both of their faces grow somber. It seems that the Yagyu executive was telling the truth, though that doesn't matter anymore.
You don't plan to go down with her.
Several contamination grenades blow up the stacked weapon boxes on the side. Black spikes are bursting out and clumping up to form filthy crawling creatures.

steps.speaker: Remnant Red Falcon
steps.content: You're not going down! I won't let you have the inheritance, and I won't let you have Syndicate! You all will die here!

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Seems that some of them fell through the cracks. Earl, protect the Bureau's team.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Haha, fine. If you can't hold it off, just scream for help.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: This time I'll save you.
No, this time you'll control how the story unfolds.
